rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides AI assistants with machine-readable Swiss agricultural environmental compliance data from BAFU, BLW, and Agroscope. Exposes 11 tools covering water protection zones, riparian buffer strip requirements, ammonia emission limits, biodiversity area requirements and payments, nutrient loss reduction targets through 2030, and environmental impact assessment thresholds. Available as a hosted remote endpoint with no authentication required.
